body.name: Width-two injectively labelled auxiliary network
body.construction:
Introduce fresh vertices \(\sigma_H,t_H\) and one fresh vertex \(a_\beta\) for every \(\beta=(x,r,e^{\to},e^{\leftrightarrow})\in\mathcal B\).  The labelled auxiliary DAG \(H^{\mathrm{aux}}\) has vertex set
\[
 \{\sigma_H,t_H\}\cup(V\setminus X)\cup\{a_\beta:\beta\in\mathcal B\}.
\]
For every \(\beta\), add \(\sigma_H\to a_\beta\), deterministic when \(e^{\leftrightarrow}\in E^{\mathrm{det}}\) and otherwise labelled by \(e^{\leftrightarrow}\in E^{?}\); add \(a_\beta\to r_\beta\), deterministic when \(e^{\to}\in E^{\mathrm{det}}\) and otherwise labelled by \(e^{\to}\in E^{?}\).  Add every directed edge \(u\to v\) of the envelope with \(u,v\in V\setminus X\), marking it deterministic or labelling it by the corresponding uncertain edge, and add deterministic \(y\to t_H\) for every \(y\in Y\).  An uncertain edge labels at most one auxiliary arc.  For \(S\subseteq E^{?}\), \(H^{\mathrm{aux}}_S\) retains all deterministic arcs and exactly the labelled arcs whose labels lie in \(S\).
